content: In all cases, we optimise our models with cross entropy loss. For deliberation network models, we first train the standard transformer model until convergence, and use it to initialise the encoder and first-pass decoder. For each of the training samples, we follow BIBREF19 and obtain a set of 10-best samples from the first pass decoder, with a beam search of size 10. We use these as the first-pass decoder samples. We use Adam as optimiser BIBREF29 and train the model until convergence.
